# CALCIUM current modulation in CSF-cNs

## **1 - CaV Modulation by GABA-B Rs**

## **1.1 - CaV Modulation in Baclofen**

```{r}

library(readxl)

BCL<- read_xlsx("BCL_INCA.xlsx")

#View(BCL)
names(BCL)

BCL$Cell ->Cell
BCL$Level ->Level
BCL$Cond->Cond
BCL$Dens->Dens

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
BCL$Cond <- factor(BCL$Cond, levels = c("CTR", "BCL", "WASH"))
BCL$Level <- factor(BCL$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
BCL$Cell <- factor(BCL$Cell)

```

### a) SUMMARIZE data for CaV modulation with Baclofen

#### Current Density CTR vs BCL

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Dens~Cond,
          BCL,
          digits=0)

Summarize(Dens~Level*Cond,
          BCL,
          digits=0)

```

### b) PLOT CaV Current modulation by Baclofen

#### Current density

```{r}

# Load necessary packages
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

unique(BCL$Cond)  # This should only return onlmy Condition
levels(BCL$Cond)  # Verify that levels match your intended order

table(BCL$Cond, useNA = "ifany")  # Includes a count of NA values
table(BCL$Level, useNA = "ifany")

# Create the plot with distributed data points
Bplot <- ggplot(BCL, aes(x = Cond, y = Dens, group = Cell, color = Level)
) +
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = "Densities by Condition and Level",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Dens") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(Bplot)
ggsave('Bplot.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# Create the plot with error bars and lines connecting the points Mean + SEM

## Use the FSA Summarize function to summarize the data by Level and Cond
summary_stats <- Summarize(Dens ~ Level * Cond, BCL, digits = 0)

## Compute SEM (Standard Error of the Mean) manually
summary_stats$sem <- summary_stats$sd / sqrt(summary_stats$n) 

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
summary_stats$Level <- factor(summary_stats$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
summary_stats$Cond <- factor(summary_stats$Cond, levels = c("CTR", "BCL", "WASH"))

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± SEM)
plotBSE <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Cond, y = mean, color = Level, group = Cond)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Cond), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SEM
  facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with SEM",
       x = "Condition",
       y = "Mean Dens") +
  theme_minimal()

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± standard deviation)
plotBSD <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Cond, y = mean, color = Level, group = Cond)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Cond), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SD
  facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with Standard Deviation",
       x = "Condition",
       y = "Mean Dens") +
  theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plotBSE)
ggsave('plotBSE.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

print(plotBSD)
ggsave('plotBSD.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```

### c) STATISTICAL analysis for CaV modulation by Baclofen

#### =\> Kruskal-Wallis Condition

```{r}
library(FSA)

kruskal.test(Dens~Cond, data = BCL)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Dens, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")
```

#### =\> Linear Model - 2 Factors Level \* Cond

#### \# Define Linear Model -) region \* Cond

```{r}
modelB = lm(Dens ~ Level*Cond,
           data = BCL)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelB)
```

#### ##Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelB,type = "II")
```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelB,
                      ~ Cond*Level,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelB, ~ Cond*Level)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Level")     # compare doses for each treat

```

## **1.2 - CaV Modulation Baclofen in CGP**

```{r}

library(readxl)

CGP<- read_xlsx("CGP_INCA.xlsx")

CGP$Cell ->Cell
```

### b) PLOT CaV Current modulation by Baclofen in CGP

#### Current density

```{r}

# Load necessary packages
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

unique(CGP$Cond)  # This should only return CTR, CGP, Wash
levels(CGP$Cond)  # Verify that levels match your intended order

table(CGP$Cond, useNA = "ifany")  # Includes a count of NA values
table(CGP$Level, useNA = "ifany")

# Create the plot with distributed data points
Gplot <- ggplot(CGP, aes(x = Cond, y = Dens, group = Cell, color = Level)
) +
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = "Densities by Condition and Level",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Dens") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(Gplot)
ggsave('Gplot.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# Create the plot with error bars and lines connecting the points Mean + SEM/SD

## Use the FSA Summarize function to summarize the data by Level and Cond
summary_stats <- Summarize(Dens ~ Level * Cond, CGP, digits = 0)

## Compute SEM (Standard Error of the Mean) manually
summary_stats$sem <- summary_stats$sd / sqrt(summary_stats$n) 

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
summary_stats$Level <- factor(summary_stats$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
summary_stats$Cond <- factor(summary_stats$Cond, levels = c("CTR", "CGP", "WASH"))

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± SEM)
plotGSE <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Cond, y = mean, color = Level, group = Cond)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Cond), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SEM
  facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with SEM",
       x = "Condition",
       y = "Mean Dens") +
  theme_minimal()

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± standard deviation)
plotGSD <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Cond, y = mean, color = Level, group = Cond)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Cond), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SD
  facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with Standard Deviation",
       x = "Condition",
       y = "Mean Dens") +
  theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plotGSE)
ggsave('plotGSE.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

print(plotGSD)
ggsave('plotGSD.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

### c) STATISTICAL analysis for CaV CURRENTS in BCL + CGP

#### =\> Kruskal-Wallis Condition

```{r}

library(FSA)

kruskal.test(Dens~Cond, data = CGP)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Dens, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Dens ~ Cond,
                    data   = CGP,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)
```

#### =\> Linear model - 2 Factors Level \* Cond

#### \# Define Linear Model -) region \* Cond

```{r}

modelC = lm(Dens ~ Level*Cond,
           data = CGP)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelC)

```

#### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

Anova(modelC,type = "II")

```

#### ###Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelC,
                      ~ Cond*Level,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelC, ~ Cond*Level)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Level")     # compare doses for each treat

```

## 1.4 Analysis on normalized currents - Cav BCL +/- CGP

### a1) Normalized Current Density CTR vs BCL alone

```{r}

library(readxl)

nBCL<- read_xlsx("BCL_nINCA.xlsx")

#View(nBCL)
names(nBCL)

nBCL$Cell ->Cell
nBCL$Level ->Level
nBCL$Cond->Cond
nBCL$nDens->nDens

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
nBCL$Cond <- factor(nBCL$Cond, levels = c("CTR", "BCL", "WASH"))
nBCL$Level <- factor(nBCL$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
nBCL$Cell <- factor(nBCL$Cell)
library(FSA)

Summarize(nDens~Cond,
          nBCL,
          digits=0)

Summarize(nDens~Level*Cond,
          nBCL,
          digits=0)

kruskal.test(nDens~Cond, data = nBCL)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(nDens, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

```

### b1) PLOT CaV normalized Current Current density

```{r}

# Load necessary packages

library(dplyr)

table(nBCL$Level, useNA = "ifany")

) +
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = "Densities by Condition and Level",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "nDens") +
    theme_minimal()

ggsave('nBplot.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# Create the plot with error bars and lines connecting the points Mean + SEM

## Compute SEM (Standard Error of the Mean) manually

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
summary_stats$Level <- factor(summary_stats$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
summary_stats$Cond <- factor(summary_stats$Cond, levels = c("CTR", "BCL", "WASH"))

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± SEM)
plotnBSE <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Cond, y = mean, color = Level, group = Cond)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Cond), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SEM
  facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with SEM",
       x = "Condition",
       y = "Mean Dens") +

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± standard deviation)
plotnBSD <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Cond, y = mean, color = Level, group = Cond)) +

  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SD
  facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with Standard Deviation",

       y = "Mean Dens") +
```

```{r}
plotnCSD <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Cond, y = mean, color = Level, group = Cond)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Cond), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points

  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with Standard Deviation",
       x = "Condition",
       y = "Mean Dens") +
  theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plotnCSE)
ggsave('plotnCSE.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

print(plotnCSD)
```

### c) STATISTICAL analysis for CaV modulation by Oxo-M


```{r}

           data = OXO)
```

```{r}

Anova(modelO,type = "II")
```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelO,
                      ~ Cond*Level,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelO, ~ Cond*Level)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Level")     # compare doses for each treat

```

```{r}
GLU<- read_xlsx("GLU_INCA.xlsx")

#View(GLU)
names(GLU)

GLU$Cell ->Cell
GLU$Level ->Level
GLU$Cond->Cond
GLU$Dens->Dens

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
GLU$Cond <- factor(GLU$Cond, levels = c("CTR", "GLU", "WASH"))

GLU$Cell <- factor(GLU$Cell)
```

### a) SUMMARIZE data for CaV modulation with Glu

#### Current Density CTR vs OXO

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Dens~Cond,
          GLU,
          digits=0)

Summarize(Dens~Level*Cond,
          GLU,
          digits=0)

```

### b) PLOT CaV Current modulation by Glu

#### Current density

```{r}

# Load necessary packages
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

unique(GLU$Cond)  # This should only return onlmy Condition
levels(GLU$Cond)  # Verify that levels match your intended order

table(GLU$Cond, useNA = "ifany")  # Includes a count of NA values
table(GLU$Level, useNA = "ifany")

# Create the plot with distributed data points
Gplot <- ggplot(GLU, aes(x = Cond, y = Dens, group = Cell, color = Level)
) +
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = "Densities by Condition and Level",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Dens") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(Gplot)
ggsave('Gplot.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# Create the plot with error bars and lines connecting the points Mean + SEM

## Use the FSA Summarize function to summarize the data by Level and Cond
summary_stats <- Summarize(Dens ~ Level * Cond, GLU, digits = 0)

## Compute SEM (Standard Error of the Mean) manually
summary_stats$sem <- summary_stats$sd / sqrt(summary_stats$n) 

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
summary_stats$Level <- factor(summary_stats$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
summary_stats$Cond <- factor(summary_stats$Cond, levels = c("CTR", "GLU", "WASH"))

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± SEM)
plotGSE <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Cond, y = mean, color = Level, group = Cond)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Cond), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SEM
  facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with SEM",
       x = "Condition",
       y = "Mean Dens") +
  theme_minimal()

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± standard deviation)
plotGSD <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Cond, y = mean, color = Level, group = Cond)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Cond), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SD
  facet_wrap(~ Level, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with Standard Deviation",
       x = "Condition",
       y = "Mean Dens") +
  theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plotGSE)
ggsave('plotGSE.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

print(plotGSD)
ggsave('plotGSD.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```

### c) STATISTICAL analysis for CaV modulation by Glu

#### =\> Kruskal-Wallis Condition

```{r}
library(FSA)

kruskal.test(Dens~Cond, data = GLU)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Dens, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")
```

#### =\> Linear Model - 2 Factors Level \* Cond

#### \# Define Linear Model -) region \* Cond

```{r}
modelG = lm(Dens ~ Level*Cond,
           data = GLU)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelG)
```

#### ##Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelG,type = "II")
```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelG,
                      ~ Cond*Level,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelG, ~ Cond*Level)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Level")     # compare doses for each treat

```

## 4.1 STATISTICAL analysis for normalized currents

### a) CTR vs BCL +/- CGP

### =\> Kruskal-Wallis Condition BCL +/- CGP

```{r}

library(readxl)
library(rcompanion)

nBCL<- read_xlsx("BCL_nINCA.xlsx")
#View(IBCL)

nBCL$Cell ->Cell
nBCL$Level ->Level
nBCL$Cond ->Cond
nBCL$nDens ->nDens

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
nBCL$Cond <- factor(nBCL$Cond, levels = c("CTR", "BCL", "WASH"))
nBCL$Level <- factor(nBCL$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
nBCL$Cell <- factor(nBCL$Cell)

print("1.1) Kruskal-Wallis test for BCL normalized current - Conditions")

kruskal.test(nDens~Cond, data = nBCL)

pairwise.wilcox.test(nDens, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

print("1.2) Kruskal-Wallis test for BCL normalized current - Levels")

kruskal.test(nDens~Level, data = nBCL)

pairwise.wilcox.test(nDens, Level,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")


nCGP<- read_xlsx("CGP_nINCA.xlsx")
#View(ICGP)

nCGP$Cell ->Cell
nCGP$Level ->Level
nCGP$Cond ->Cond
nCGP$nDens ->nDens

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
nCGP$Cond <- factor(nCGP$Cond, levels = c("CTR","CGP", "WASH"))
nCGP$Level <- factor(nCGP$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
nCGP$Cell <- factor(nCGP$Cell)

print("2.1) Kruskal-Wallis test for BCL in CGP inhibition - Conditions")

kruskal.test(nDens~Cond, data = nCGP)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(nDens, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

print(" 2.2) Kruskal-Wallis test for BCL in CGP inhibition - Levels")

kruskal.test(nDens~Level, data = nCGP)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(nDens, Level,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")
```

### =\> Linear model BCL alone - 2 Factors Condition \* Level

```{r}
           data = nBCL)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelnB)

```

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

Anova(modelnB,type = "II")

```

```{r}

leastsquare = emmeans(modelnB,
                      ~ Cond*Level,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelnB, ~ Cond*Level)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Level")     # compare doses for each treat

```

### =\> Friedman test BCL alone

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(knitr)  # For tables
library(gt)     # For better table formatting

# Test data with Friedmlan test
friedman_results <- nBCL %>%
  group_by(Level) %>%
  friedman_test(nDens ~ Cond | Cell)

#colnames(friedman_results)
#str(friedman_results)
```

#### #Pairwise comparison in one Level against condition / **Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) correction**

```{r}

pairwise_results <- nBCL %>%
  group_by(Level) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(nDens ~ Cond, paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "BH")

```

#### \## Print Test results

```{r}


print(friedman_results)

# Print Pairwise Wilcoxon results with p-values and BH correction
pairwise_results %>% select(Level, group1, group2, p, p.adj)

```


### =\> Friedman test GLU alone

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(knitr)  # For tables
library(gt)     # For better table formatting

# Test data with Friedmlan test
friedman_results <- GLU %>%
  group_by(Level) %>%
  friedman_test(Dens ~ Cond | Cell)

#colnames(friedman_results)
#str(friedman_results)
```

#### #Pairwise comparison in one Level against condition / **Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) correction**

```{r}

pairwise_results <- GLU %>%
  group_by(Level) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(Dens ~ Cond, paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "BH")

```

#### ##Print Test results

```{r}

print(friedman_results)

# Print Pairwise Wilcoxon results with p-values and BH correction
pairwise_results %>% select(Level, group1, group2, p, p.adj)

```

```{r}
library(readxl)
```

#### s=\> Linear model - 2 Factors Condition \* Level

#### \# Define Linear Model -) region \* Cond

```{r}

modelIBO = lm(Inh ~ Level*Cond,
           data = IBO)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelIBO)


```

#### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelIBO,type = "II")

```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelIBO,
                      ~ Cond*Level,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelIB, ~ Cond*Level)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Level")     # compare doses for each treat

```
